build_wmt_translate_dataset: build a WMT translation dataset using WmtConfig with a custom language pair and subsets for training and validation splits
create_wmt_config: create a WmtConfig specifying language pair, subsets per split, and version for a WMT translation dataset builder
parse_parallel_sentences: parse parallel sentence pairs from two text or SGML files and yield aligned examples keyed by file and line index
parse_tmx_file: parse a TMX bilingual corpus file and yield translation examples extracted from each <tu> element
parse_czeng_corpus: parse CzEng parallel Czech-English corpus files with optional block filtering for v1.7 quality control
